items.statement: The calculation is bound to the exact CCDC 2340654 experimental structure of complex 1 and an explicitly identified Co(II) site, with preserved connectivity and site identity.
items.expected: The submitted report names CCDC 2340654, identifies complex 1 as [Co2Li2(2-furoate)6(4-phenylpyridine)2], and records the selected Co site, oxidation state, multiplicity and coordination environment.

items.statement: A reproducible multireference/spin–orbit protocol and its diagnostics are reported, including state treatment and convergence or a diagnosed bounded failure.
items.expected: The report records software, model description, state treatment, geometry handling, convergence/failure diagnostics, and the spin-free/spin–orbit states used; it does not present an unsupported success claim.

items.statement: The computed single-site spin-Hamiltonian observables are reported with units and bound to the selected site.
items.expected: A successful report provides D in cm^-1, E/D, three principal g values, and the lowest KD gap in cm^-1; a bounded-failure report gives no fabricated observables and documents the blocker.

items.statement: The low-lying Kramers-doublet result is checked as a state-resolved validation rather than inferred from D alone.
items.expected: The successful result resolves a ground KD and first excited KD and reports their gap; the interpretation recognizes that the first excited KD is above the ground state and that state mixing is relevant.
